record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: movement-triggered debuff (no PassiveEffects entry; checked inside MovingState.move at the dark jump)
record.summary: Passive.PARTING_SHOT has NO entry in PassiveEffects (routing uncertainty NO_PASSIVE_EFFECTS_ENTRY); its only caller is the dark-jump branch of MovingState.move, and the name PARTING_SHOT is shared with EffectEnum.PARTING_SHOT (NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT), which is the marker put on the debuffed enemy. PANCHAM (1 star) and PANGORO (2 stars) are FIGHTING + DARK, range 1, maxPP 100. When such a unit moves (no target at range, a target at sight, and it can move), the DARK-synergy, range-1, non-locked branch makes it jump to the free cell next to the farthest targettable enemy instead of pathfinding; if that farthest enemy does not already carry the PARTING_SHOT effect, partingShot is called on it before the swap: requested AP -20 (addAbilityPower, caster = the jumper, apBoost 0, no crit) and requested ATK -0.2 x the target's baseAtk (addAttack, apBoost 0, no crit), then the marker effect is added so the same enemy is not debuffed twice (by any Pancham/Pangoro, since the marker lives on the target). Applied changes can differ from the requests: AP -20 is rounded and goes through Big Eater Belt (not applied: negative change from an enemy) and Twist Band (a target holding it receives +20 AP instead); a target holding NULLIFY_BANDANNA turns the AP request into an addAttack of round(0.2 x -20) = -4; ATK is clamped to at least 1 and a Twist Band turns -0.2 x baseAtk into a gain; baseAtk is the unit's base attack, not its current attack. Only the farthest target (not an area) is affected. No gameplay claims.
triggers: MovingState.move: dark-jump branch (pokemon.types has DARK, range 1, passive not GUZZLORD, not status.locked) when a farthest target and a free cell exist
passive check: pokemon.passive === Passive.PARTING_SHOT and the chosen target lacks EffectEnum.PARTING_SHOT

effects.declaredRaw: -20 ability power on the farthest enemy
effects.scaling: addAbilityPower(-20, jumper, apBoost 0, crit false): no AP or crit scaling
effects.resolution: requested -20. Applied: Math.round, Big Eater Belt only for positive values or negative values from the same team (the caster is an enemy, so not applied), Twist Band on the target turns -20 into +20 (caster is an enemy), ap = max(-100, ap + value); if the target holds NULLIFY_BANDANNA the request becomes addAttack(round(0.2 x -20) = -4, jumper, 0, false) instead and the AP is unchanged

effects.declaredRaw: -20 percent of the target base attack
effects.scaling: addAttack(-0.2 x target.baseAtk, jumper, 0, false): the factor multiplies baseAtk (not current atk); AP boost 0 so caster AP is irrelevant
effects.resolution: requested -0.2 x baseAtk; applied: Math.round of the value, Big Eater Belt not applied (enemy source, negative), Twist Band on the target flips it into a gain, atk = max(1, atk + value). Temporary fight stat (permanent not set)

effects.declaredRaw: EffectEnum.PARTING_SHOT added to the target effects
effects.resolution: the marker is checked on the farthest target before the call, so an enemy already marked is skipped (the jump still happens). The marker is a Set member on the target and no removal was found in the files searched

effects.declaredRaw: jump to the free cell next to the farthest enemy
effects.resolution: getFarthestTargetCoordinateAvailablePlace(pokemon): strictly greater distance replaces the previous target; for the chosen target the free adjacent cell farthest from the jumper is selected (selectedCell is replaced whenever a farther target is found, and kept when the farther target has no free adjacent cell, so the selectedCell may belong to an earlier, nearer target - in that case target and cell can differ; the target field is set from the entity that produced the selected cell); fallback closest free cell of the farthest target

conditions: Requires pokemon.types to include DARK, range 1, passive other than GUZZLORD and not status.locked (any other DARK range-1 unit takes the same jump but only PARTING_SHOT carriers apply the debuff).
Fires when move() is called and a farthest-coordinate result exists; not on attack or cast.
The debuff is skipped if the farthest target already has the PARTING_SHOT marker.
record.resetBehaviour: The marker effect stays on the target for the rest of the fight (no removal found); the debuffs are not undone. Fight stats are rebuilt for the next fight (not traced).

evidence.note: addAttack: Math.round of value x (1 + apBoost x caster AP / 100) x critPower if crit, then Big Eater Belt and Twist Band helpers, then atk = max(1, atk + value); temporary unless permanent
plain functions: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down on positive changes; Twist Band flips negative changes from enemies/environment
PANCHAM: 1 star, FIGHTING + DARK, maxPP 100, range 1, skill ARM_THRUST
PANGORO: 2 stars, FIGHTING + DARK, maxPP 100, range 1, skill ARM_THRUST

partingShot(pokemon, target, x, y): target.addAbilityPower(-20, pokemon, 0, false); target.addAttack(-0.2 x target.baseAtk, pokemon, 0, false); adds EffectEnum.PARTING_SHOT to target.effects; x, y are only passed to the ability broadcast

DARK-synergy range-1 unit that is not GUZZLORD and not status.locked jumps to the farthest-target cell instead of pathfinding; PARTING_SHOT is applied to farthestCoordinate.target only if it does not already carry EffectEnum.PARTING_SHOT, before the swap

move() is reached from the moving state when no target is at range, the unit is not casting or drumming, a target is at sight and canMove (the charm branch at lines 30-39 also calls move toward the charm origin)

picks the strictly farthest targettable enemy (first one wins ties, distanceM), then the free adjacent cell of that target farthest from the caster; selectedCell is re-selected each time a farther target is found; fallback getClosestAvailablePlace of the farthest target; returns null if none

evidence.expect: this.addAttack(Math.round(0.2 * value), caster, 0, false) // AP is gained as Attack instead
evidence.note: NULLIFY_BANDANNA on the receiver converts AP change into addAttack(round(0.2 x value)); otherwise round, Big Eater Belt / Twist Band helpers, ap = max(-100, ap + value)
